candidates.title: Mascot Guided Selection Redesign for Pick Friend Screen
candidates.change: Redesigns the friend selection screen into a spotlight layout featuring an animated mascot preview that showcases each pet's distinct idle behavior.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion drops to 74.7% with a median time of 89s; interactive spotlight previews assist users in choosing faster.

pick_friend.headline: Meet Your New Desktop Companion
pick_friend.body: Select a pet companion to watch their personality traits live on your screen.

guard.reason: 'pick_friend.replace.pet_choices[0]': a mascot cannot do the pet_choices job (use ['animation', 'button', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'preview', 'text'])

candidates.title: Interactive Pet Trait Personality Quiz Screen
candidates.change: Adds a quick pet personality trait quiz screen right before photo customization to match users with pet companion behaviors.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets noted confusion or issues during pet customization, while adoption step mean duration is 1017s.

new_trait_quiz.headline: What behavior best fits your desktop?
new_trait_quiz.body: Answer 2 quick questions so your pet adapts to your work style.

guard.reason: Adds a new trait quiz screen inside onboarding without removing or skipping any required steps.

candidates.score_note: Targeted step has long duration (1017s) and 25.3% drop, but adding a quiz screen requires a release.

candidates.title: Instant Pet Mini Game Sub Flow While Spawning
candidates.change: Introduces an interactive mini-game sub-flow directly on the waiting screen while the pet engine initializes in the background.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a median duration of 201s and a mean of 2336s, causing drop-offs and desktop launch confusion.

waiting.headline: Your Pet is Getting Ready!
waiting.body: Play a quick reaction mini-game while we set up your pet's desktop home.

guard.reason: replacement for 'waiting.wait_status' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['preview', 'progress', 'timer']

candidates.title: Reorder Sign In After Adoption Certificate Step
candidates.change: Moves the sign-in requirement until after the user finalizes their pet adoption certificate and names their pet.
candidates.why: Signing in before pet creation causes early drop-off; placing sign-in after certificate creation leverages psychological ownership.

guard.reason: Reorders sign-in to take place after adoption certificate, which is explicitly allowed.

candidates.score_note: Delaying sign-in leverages ownership, but reordering steps requires structural release.

candidates.title: Existing Account Pet Restore & Sync Assurance Banner
candidates.change: Adds an explicit account synchronization notice explaining how previously created pets are restored automatically.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or account reset after signing in.

sign_in.hint: Signing in with an existing account automatically restores all saved pets and adoption history.

guard.reason: Adds account restoration hint text on the sign-in screen without violating any onboarding limits.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from 8 support complaints regarding missing pet sync at sign-in.

candidates.title: Desktop Safety Diagnostic & Progress Waiting Indicator
candidates.change: Displays an active system verification checklist and estimated countdown on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: 3 support complaints mentioned the app failing to open or pet not showing on desktop, plus high waiting time.

waiting.hint: Verifying desktop display compatibility and screen layer permissions...

guard.reason: Updates waiting screen diagnostic information and progress feedback as permitted.

candidates.score_note: High wait time (2336s) causes drop-off; clear progress indicators mitigate drop.

candidates.title: Compact Checklist Layout for Adoption Certificate
candidates.change: Switches adoption certificate screen layout to a checklist format summarizing pet traits, name, and desktop permissions.
candidates.why: Adoption step has a 74.7% conversion rate; a clear summary checklist reduces ambiguity before final spawn.

adoption_certificate.headline: Confirm Adoption Details
adoption_certificate.body: Review your desktop pet summary and sign the official certificate.
adoption_certificate.hint: Your pet will be saved to your account upon signing.

guard.reason: Replaces the adoption certificate layout with a checklist that loses the required official stamp job.

candidates.title: Desktop Controls & Interaction Quick Reference Headline
candidates.change: Updates the final intro screen copy to provide a quick guide on system tray controls, hiding, and talking to the pet.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or interact with the pet.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Live! Here is How to Interact
home_intro.body: Right-click the system tray icon to hide or customize. Click your pet anytime to talk or play!

guard.reason: Updates copy on the home intro screen to guide desktop interactions within onboarding bounds.

candidates.score_note: Finish step has the highest drop rate (28.3%); quick copy-only fix makes cost very low.

candidates.title: Desktop Ready Audio Alert & System Notification Toggle
candidates.change: Adds an optional sound notification and system alert toggle when rendering finishes on the desktop background.
candidates.why: Mean waiting time is 2336s; users switch tasks while waiting and miss when the pet spawns.

guard.reason: Adds notification settings and audio alerts to the waiting screen as allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Addresses task-switching during 2336s wait time, but notification integration requires code release.

candidates.title: Starter Pet Accessory Unlock Completion Incentive
candidates.change: Offers an exclusive free desktop accessory item upon completing the final onboarding tour step.
candidates.why: Finish step drop-off is 71.7% with a mean duration of 5815s; rewarding completion reduces drop-off.

home_intro.headline: Claim Your Free Welcome Gift!
home_intro.body: Finish this 30-second introduction to unlock an exclusive starter toy for your pet.
home_intro.hint: Gift item will automatically be added to your pet's desktop inventory.

guard.reason: Mentions a free welcome gift and unlocked starter toy in onboarding copy, violating pricing copy rules.
